name: Stuffed Lamb Tomatoes
assumptions: Recipe serves 4 people (one large stuffed tomato per serving, standard for this style of Greek dish)
Total active and passive time estimated from instructions: ~10 min prep + 10 min onion/garlic cook + 15 min simmer + 35 min bake = 70 minutes
Gluten-free: all ingredients compatible; rice is assumed plain uncooked rice with no additives
Dairy-free: no milk or dairy products listed
No tree nuts, peanuts, sesame, fish, shellfish, eggs, milk, soy, or wheat listed or implied
Chicken stock assumed to be a basic stock without wheat/soy/sesame additives
instructions:
Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Slice the tops off the tomatoes and reserve. Scoop out most of the pulp with a teaspoon, being careful not to break the skin. Finely chop the pulp, and keep any juices. Sprinkle the insides of the tomatoes with a little sugar to take away the acidity, then place them on a baking tray.

Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan, add the onion and garlic, then gently cook for about 10 mins until soft but not coloured. Add the lamb, cinnamon and tomato purée, turn up the heat, then fry until the meat is browned. Add the tomato pulp and juice, the rice and the stock. Season generously. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 15 mins or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Set aside to cool a little, then stir in the herbs.

Stuff the tomatoes up to the brim, top tomatoes with their lids, drizzle with 2 tbsp more olive oil, sprinkle 3 tbsp water into the tray, then bake for 35 mins. Serve with salad and crusty bread, hot or cold.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 4 large tomatoes, each ~200g raw; standard medium-large tomato size used for Greek stuffed tomato recipes

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of sugar estimated at 2g; typical small pinch amount for 4 tomatoes to reduce acidity

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tbsp olive oil total (2 tbsp for frying + 2 tbsp for drizzling); 1 tbsp = 13.5g

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 chopped medium onion, standard 110g raw weight

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 2 finely chopped garlic cloves, each ~3g raw

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.assumptions: 200g raw minced/ground lamb as listed; typical values for raw lamb shoulder mince

ingredients.name: Cinnamon
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp ground cinnamon; typical density ~8g per tbsp

ingredients.name: Tomato Puree
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp tomato puree/paste; 1 tbsp ~15g, typical concentrated values

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.assumptions: 50g uncooked white rice as listed; typical long-grain rice values

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: 100ml chicken stock; typical ready-to-use stock values, ~1:1 ml-to-g density

ingredients.name: Dill
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tbsp chopped fresh dill; 1 tbsp ~5g, typical fresh herb density

ingredients.name: Chopped Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley; 1 tbsp ~5g, typical fresh herb density

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp chopped fresh mint; 1 tbsp ~5g, typical fresh herb density
